title: Mom's Misinformation Machine: science and space expansion v2
scope: New distinct named subjects only, compared against the 47-subject main catalog. Not a complete encyclopedia or complete conspiracy database.
source_policy: Primary institutional source for every precise statement. Original concise wording, no copied articles or images; source review notes identify boundaries. Some false science rumors are misinformation rather than literal secret-plot narratives and are labeled accordingly.
familiarity_policy: Editorial relative familiarity from 0 (general/common) to 5 (obscure); independent of the eight flight depths and not measured player-answer frequencies.
medical_scope: Vaccine cards grade narrowly scoped historical misinformation, not personal medical advice or current eligibility recommendations. The archived CDC source is dated August 18, 2021.
release_policy: Source-checked proposals for the release captain to integrate and verify; no app or live source changes made by this file.
